title: GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 DualSense Controllers Revealed at State of Play
description: Two limited edition Grand Theft Auto 6 PS5 DualSense controllers have been officially revealed during Sony's latest State of Play livestream.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 PS5 DualSense Controllers Announced

During the latest Sony State of Play livestream, gaming media outlet Eurogamer reported an exciting new reveal for fans eagerly anticipating *Grand Theft Auto VI*. Two limited edition *Grand Theft Auto 6* PS5 DualSense controllers were officially showcased during the broadcast, catching the attention of the global gaming community.

As one of the most anticipated titles in gaming history, any official merchandise or hardware tie-in related to *GTA 6* generates immense excitement. The unveiling of these two limited edition controllers during such a major Sony showcase highlights the massive scale of the upcoming release and the partnership surrounding its promotional rollout.

## What We Know So Far

While the State of Play livestream gave players their first look at the two limited edition controllers, specific details regarding exact pricing, release dates, and pre-order availability were not detailed in the initial reveal. Historically, major franchise-themed hardware releases become highly sought-after collector's items among fans. The advanced features of the DualSense controller—such as haptic feedback and adaptive triggers—also present exciting possibilities for how players might physically experience the streets of Vice City when paired with the game.

Fans looking to add these exclusive items to their collection should keep a close eye on upcoming announcements from official channels for further purchasing details.

## Editor's Take

Hardware collaborations like these are a staple for blockbuster game launches, and bringing two limited edition *GTA 6* DualSense controllers to the State of Play livestream is a brilliant move by Sony. While we await more concrete release details, these controllers are shaping up to be must-have items for hardcore fans and collectors alike.
